key.name: hive-url
key.description: Base URL of the hive dashboard, e.g. https://hive.example.org — no trailing slash. Empty means the extension stays idle rather than polling a guessed host.

key.name: hive-token
key.description: Sent as the X-Hive-Internal header. This is the value of the hive's HIVE_DASHBOARD_TOKEN secret. It is the only credential the hive accepts for server-to-server reads: the Bearer path is disabled on a direct-route spoke, and a browser session cookie is not something an extension can obtain.

key.name: github-repo
key.description: owner/name of the repository an idea becomes an issue in. It should be one of the hive's managed repos, or the governor will never see it.

key.name: github-token
key.description: Token used to open the issue, needing only issues:write on the target repository. Kept separate from the hive token because they are different credentials for different services.

key.name: idea-labels
key.summary: Labels applied to a new idea
key.description: Comma-separated. Defaults to the label hive's own ACMM issue creator uses to mean "an agent should pick this up".

key.name: show-counts
key.summary: Show queue counts in the top bar
key.description: When off, the panel shows only the status dot and governor mode, which is quieter on a narrow top bar.
